status_classes.CONFIRMED_BARIAH: Bariah ruled it directly, in the annotated deck or the completed review guide.
status_classes.CONFIRMED_CAIR_ADOPTION: Adopted from S&G v0.3 or inferred from a Bariah scoping qualifier; not attributable to a Bariah comment in her own words.
status_classes.PENDING_SOURCE_VERIFICATION: Ruling is clear but rests on a factual claim not yet traced to the module source.
status_classes.PENDING_FIRDAUS_CONFIRMATION: Bariah explicitly routed the decision to Firdaus.
status_classes.PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME: Policy confirmed; the concrete names were not supplied and must not be invented.
status_classes.CONFIRMED_CANON: A canon character confirmed for the PL06 / K5 cast.
status_classes.CONFIRMED_NARRATOR: The confirmed course narrator, distinct from the scenario cast.
status_classes.PENDING_BARIAH_CONFIRMATION: Execution policy is set for the review build; Bariah must confirm the final form.
status_classes.TECHNICAL_DECOMPOSITION_FROM_SOURCE: Interaction items derived from the module source’s own labelled substructure; no stakeholder ruling required and no source row created.
status_classes.PENDING_ARTIFACT_DELIVERY: The ruling is confirmed and modelled; only the byte-level freeze of a supplied artifact is outstanding because the file did not reach the execution environment.
status_classes.RESOLVED_ARTIFACT_FROZEN: A previously pending artifact freeze that is now closed: the bytes were received, independently hashed, and match the declared identity.
status_classes.CONFIRMED_REGRESSION: A defect Bariah found in generated output. Corrected in the source-controlled pipeline, never by patching the PowerPoint.
status_classes.CONFIRMED_LOCAL_ARTIFACT: The value is used consistently in the generated artifacts, but its provenance is task transcript only: no frozen Bariah artifact contains it. Not the same as CONFIRMED_BARIAH.
